title: Rotisserie, Panels, Pressure, Liquid & Ranges
description: Five live drops: a scroll-driven 3D card rotisserie, drag-resizable split panels, cursor-proximity variable type, spring-bounce liquid toggles, and a two-month date range picker.

drops.title: Scroll Rotisserie
drops.description: Cards tumble through 3D space purely as a function of scroll position, no animation library involved.
drops.concept: Each card's distance from the viewport center is measured on every scroll event and mapped to a rotateX/rotateY angle, plus a translateZ depth shift and opacity fade — the classic 'GSAP scroll rotation' technique rebuilt with a plain scroll listener, rAF batching, and CSS 3D transforms.
drops.source: Codrops tutorial: 3D Image Rotations on Scroll

interaction.click: drag the max-angle / axis-mix sliders to retune the effect
interaction.touch: scroll normally; rotation fires on scroll position

drops.title: Split Studio
drops.description: Drag-resizable panel groups with 2/3-pane and horizontal/vertical layout presets.
drops.concept: A panel group tracks each pane's size as a percentage of flex-basis; dragging a handle converts the pointer's pixel position into a local split ratio between just the two adjacent panes, mirroring the resizable-panel-group model used by modern editor and dashboard UIs.

interaction.mouse: drag any divider to resize; click the toolbar to switch presets
interaction.click: toolbar buttons switch between 2-pane, 3-pane, and vertical layouts
interaction.touch: dividers respond to touch drag via Pointer Events

drops.title: Pressure Type
drops.description: Every character independently swells in weight, width and slant based on its own distance to the cursor.
drops.concept: On every animation frame, each letter span measures its own bounding-box distance to the pointer and writes a per-character font-variation-settings string (wght/wdth/ital) plus a small scale/lift transform — the mechanism behind reactbits.dev's viral 'Text Pressure' component, applied across three differently-styled headlines at once.

interaction.mouse: move across any line of text to swell nearby letters
interaction.click: drag Radius / Weight swing sliders to retune the field
interaction.touch: touchmove drives the same proximity field on touch devices

drops.title: Liquid Toggle Bank
drops.description: A spring-bounce glass switch, a liquid segmented control, and a fill-drag confirm slider.
drops.concept: Three distinct toggle mechanics share one glassy visual language: a boolean switch with a keyframe overshoot bounce on every flip, a segmented control whose highlight pill morphs its left/width to the active button, and a slide-to-confirm pill that fills with color as you drag and locks in past a threshold.

interaction.mouse: click the switch/segments; drag the pill's knob to confirm
interaction.click: click toggles the switch and segmented control
interaction.touch: all three toggles respond to touch via Pointer Events

drops.title: Range Calendar
drops.description: A two-month date range picker with quick presets, live trigger label, and in-range highlighting.
drops.concept: A left/right pair of month grids share one range state; clicking a start then end date highlights everything between with a continuous pill shape across day cells, and preset chips (7/14/30 days, this month) jump straight to a computed range — the shape of the date-range components landing in design systems' mid-2026 releases.
drops.source: Nord Design System's July 2026 Date Range Picker component

interaction.mouse: click a start then end date; click preset chips for quick ranges
interaction.touch: calendar cells and presets are tap-friendly
